title: Sailor
name: Marston
description: A retired seaman who keeps the boarding house with the discipline he once ran a deck with. Something followed him back from the waters off this coast, a sickness of the mind he has taken to calling the Dream of the Abyss, and he has spent years learning to live around it rather than beat it. He keeps quiet hours and expects the same of his guests, because he has found that quiet helps.
history: He spent thirty years at sea before the waters off the Estate's coast took his ship and most of his crew. He came out of it with a bad leg and something worse, which comes and goes in stages he has learned to recognise and cannot predict. He took over the abandoned boarding house while recovering and has kept it since, for the sort of people who still go down to that harbour.
summary: A watchful and taciturn retired Sailor who keeps The Stumbling Corpse, and the sickness he calls the Dream of the Abyss.

appearance.features: Thick beard, anchor tattoo on forearm, pronounced limp

notes: Keeps his house quiet after dark, and puts out anyone who will not.
Has recorded the stages of his own sickness for years, and can recognise the signs in others before they can.
Keeps a dried flower at his bedside that he believes keeps the worst of it away.
Walks with a bad leg from the wreck, resting his hands on a gnarled cane.
Spends many evenings smoking with the Blacksmith.
